title: A vendor on a deactivated term shows it as inactive until another is picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure vendor A holds Net 60, which is deactivated. Vendor B holds Net 30.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open vendor A's vendor page.
  2. Open Edit Vendor.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
  4. Choose "Net 45".
  5. Click Save & Close.
  6. Open Edit Vendor for vendor B.
  7. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Credit term" reads "Net 60 (Inactive)".

Step 2:

  • "Net 60 (Inactive)" is selected in Credit Terms.

Step 3:

  • "Net 60 (Inactive)" is listed after the active terms.

Step 4:

  • The dropdown shows Net 45.

Step 5:

  • The vendor saves on Net 45.

Step 6:

  • It reads Net 30.

Step 7:

  • Net 60 is not offered to vendor B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R3: “A vendor on a deactivated term shows "{name} (Inactive)" on the vendor card's "Credit term" and selected in Edit Vendor, listed after the active terms, until someone picks another.”
  • S6-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a vendor not already on them.”
  • Terminology: “Inactive → A deactivated term: absent from the customer and vendor pickers, still held by whoever had it, and shown as "{name} (Inactive)" on their card and in Edit.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

  • “A vendor not on Net 10 is never offered it.”
